resumeText:
Imran Shaikh | Ahmedabad | imran.shaikh@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Was on the on-call rotation and wrote incident reports after outages.

Junior System Administrator, Sabarmati Data Centre Services (2019 - 2020)
